title: HTTP Client
concept: HTTP client with xiom.http — make GET/POST requests, handle headers, parse responses, and build API clients in XIOM.
why: Almost every application communicates over HTTP. Whether calling REST APIs, fetching data, or posting metrics, HTTP is the backbone of modern networked software.
tips: Always check response status — 2xx is success, 4xx is client error, 5xx is server error
Use the Client builder for shared configuration (timeout, headers, auth) — reuse it across requests
Set timeouts — network requests without timeouts can hang forever
Use async HTTP for concurrent requests — sequential requests waste time
common_mistakes: Not checking response status — assuming 200 when server returns 500
Forgetting to set Content-Type header on POST requests — servers may reject the body
Hardcoding API tokens in source code — use environment variables or config files
